```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```
## Load the data
```{r}
positions <- read_csv("data/raw/sea_2026-10-15_17utc.csv")
head(positions)
```
## Sanity Checks
```{r}
nrow(positions)
n_distinct(positions$icao24)
```
```{r}
n_distinct(positions$callsign)
max(positions$baroaltitude)
```
## All traffic
```{r}
library(leaflet)


leaflet(positions) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addCircleMarkers(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, radius = 1, stroke = FALSE,
                   fillOpacity = 0.5,
                   popup = ~paste(callsign, "-", round(baroaltitude), "m"))
```
## Arrivals Only
```{r}
# SEA Airport location
sea_lat <- 47.449
sea_lon <- -122.309

# One summary row per flight
flights <- positions |>
  arrange(icao24, time) |>
  group_by(icao24, callsign) |>
  summarise(
    start_alt = first(baroaltitude),
    end_alt = last(baroaltitude),
    end_lat = last(lat),
    end_lon = last(lon),
    n_points = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# IDs of the arriving aircraft
arrival_ids <- flights |>
  filter(end_alt < 1000,
         end_alt < start_alt,
         abs(end_lat - sea_lat) < 0.15,
         abs(end_lon - sea_lon) < 0.15) |>
  pull(icao24)
#All positions for just those aircraft
arrivals <- positions |>
  filter(icao24 %in% arrival_ids) |>
  arrange(icao24, time)

length(arrival_ids)
```
```{r}
# Turn between two headings, from -180 to 180 (handles 350 -> 10 = +20)
heading_change <- function(from, to) {
  ((to - from + 540) %% 360) - 180
}

turning <- arrivals |>
  group_by(icao24, callsign) |>
  mutate(turn = heading_change(lag(heading), heading)) |>
  summarise(
    total_turn = sum(abs(turn), na.rm = TRUE),
    mintues    = (max(time) - min(time)) / 60,
    .groups    = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(total_turn))
head(turning, 10)
```
```{r}
pick <- "DAL868"

one <- arrivals |>
  filter(str_trim(callsign) == pick) |>
  arrange(time)

leaflet(one) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolylines(lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat, weight = 3, color = "red") |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = head(one, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                   radius = 6, color = "green", label = "start") |>
  addCircleMarkers(data = tail(one, 1), lng = ~lon, lat = ~lat,
                   radius = 6, color = "black", label = "end")
```
